    days = ["monday", "tuesday", "wednesday", "thursday", "friday", "saturday", "sunday"]
    start_day, end_day = input().strip(), input().strip()
    
    # Calculate the difference in days between the two given days
    start_index = days.index(start_day)
    end_index = days.index(end_day)
    day_difference = (end_index - start_index + 7) % 7
    
    # Check if the day difference is 1 or 6 (since 365 % 7 == 1)
    return "YES" if day_difference == 1 or day_difference == 6 else "NO"
